title: PlanExecuteResponse
description: The answer of `POST /v1/plans/{planId}/execute` (06 §5): one interactive generation job per generate step of the chosen variants. `variant` is the index into the stored plan, so the client can attach each job's partials to the right candidate commit.

estimatedCredits.description: What this job was charged, from the credit table (05 §9).

ExecuteJobStatus.description: `queued` for an executed plan: execute is interactive, so a spent GPU budget is a 503 rather than a paused job (05 §9).
